final_assessment: Archived tighten-bodies to orbit/changes/archive/2026-11-17-tighten-bodies/: four requirements added and four modified across orbit-conventions, orbit-emit-composition and orbit-skill-generation, synced through the engine and byte-verified; the pre-archive audit found no critical drift and no warnings.

judgements.reasoning: Both cadences ran in full: a blind pair at proposal and at system, each walked, each followed by an in-context verification that was walked in turn. Every finding the system cadence raised was record-keeping (a named limit's wording, two stale figures, the decision records' readability); none changed what an agent is told to do, and the edit ledger reconciles every edited body to its recorded hash.

accepted.claim: About 115 provenance forms remain in the twelve tightened bodies (forms outside the six kinds, and in-kind members the patterns cannot remove), recorded in the account.
accepted.why: The stage's rule removes only what its patterns cover; the fresh system pass named the in-kind ones and the walk made the named limit say so (D-tb-18); whether to widen the patterns is the evaluation's.

accepted.claim: The external system pass returned no findings after a light read: no lens files exist, so it walked no perspectives or critical paths.
accepted.why: The fresh half of the same pair read the generated bodies at the change start and at HEAD and found the substantive items; the pair together covered the change.
